这是杨蜜进组第五天。

前三天，她一直在了解人物关系。

后面两天，主动出击，努力融入这个小团体。

首先是糖嫣，这女人不简单。

来之前她就知道，唐雪见这个角色是从糖嫣身上硬生生扒下来的。

按理来说，糖嫣不会给她好脸色。

这种事情换谁都会受不了。

她从小在片场混，遇到过不少委屈，但也比不上糖嫣这次。

结果没想到进组第一天，却是糖嫣先跟她打招呼。

这女孩总是喜欢笑，看起来傻傻的。

可她的行为却让杨蜜不敢轻视，两人一直保持着表面闺蜜的关系。

其次就是刘施施，这女生更好交流一点，城府不深，有什么事都写在脸上。

她喜欢跟这样的女孩交朋友，不会这么累。

相比起女生，和男生交朋友更简单，只可惜魏沐一直对她爱答不理的，有点难搞。

“呀，你们俩买这么多。”

杨蜜绕到她们身后，若有所思的打量起来。

“嗯。来吃点呗。”

“不用，我来之前吃了一些。”

本着不得罪两人的想法，杨蜜快速给出合适理由。

“哦，那好。等林哥还有小王来了分给他们吃。”

见俩人默契的没有提起某个人，杨蜜心里有了计较。

看来是碰巧。

联想起魏沐前几天请大家吃早饭，她很快理清思路。

刘施施和糖嫣心血来潮，想请大家吃早饭，没想到撞车。

而狗日的老胡早就知道，就是没跟她提前说。

这俩人的目标肯定不是她也不是老胡，而是那个男人——魏沐

想到这里，杨蜜心中升起幸灾乐祸，她非常好奇对方怎么处理这种情况。

“老胡，你杵这儿干嘛？”

玛德，怎么又问我一遍？

站在门口吹热风的胡哥看到来人，嘴角抽了抽：“你小心点，糖嫣和施施都想请你吃早餐。”

“哦。吃就吃呗，我正好没吃。”

草.....你这种蜜汁自信到底从哪里学的？

要不是拉不下脸，胡哥当场就想纳头便拜——大佬教我一下

哼着小曲，魏沐大步走进化妆间。

“各位，早上好啊。”

This is Yang Mi’s fifth day in the group.

In the past three days, she had been learning about the relationships between the characters.

In the next two days, I took the initiative and tried to integrate into this small group.

The first is Tang Yan, this woman is not simple.

She knew before she came that Tang Xuejian's role was ripped off from Tang Yan.

Logically speaking, Tang Yan would not give her a good look.

No one can bear this kind of thing.

She has been on the set since she was a child and has encountered many grievances, but nothing like Tang Yan this time.

Unexpectedly, on the first day she joined the group, it was Tang Yan who greeted her first.

This girl always likes to laugh and look silly.

But her behavior made Yang Mi dare not take her lightly, and the two of them have always maintained a superficial relationship of best friends.

The second is Liu Shishi. This girl is easier to communicate with. She is not deep in the city and everything is written on her face.

She likes to make friends with girls like this, she won't be so tired.

Compared with girls, it is easier to make friends with boys. Unfortunately, Wei Mu has always been indifferent to her, which is a bit difficult to deal with.

"Yeah, you two bought so much."

Yang Mi walked around behind them and looked at them thoughtfully.

"Yeah. Let's have some."

"No, I ate some before coming here."

In order not to offend the two of them, Yang Mi quickly gave a suitable reason.

"Oh, that's good. When Brother Lin and Xiao Wang come, share it with them."

Seeing that the two of them had a tacit agreement not to mention a certain person, Yang Mi started to worry.

It seems to be a coincidence.

Reminiscing that Wei Mu invited everyone to have breakfast a few days ago, she quickly straightened out her thoughts.

Liu Shishi and Tang Yan wanted to treat everyone to breakfast on a whim, but they didn't expect a car crash.

And the stubborn old Hu had known it for a long time, but he just didn't tell her in advance.

The target of these two people is definitely not her or Lao Hu, but that man - Wei Mu

Thinking of this, Yang Mi felt gloating in her heart, and she was very curious about how the other party would handle this situation.

"Lao Hu, what are you doing here?"

Mad, why are you asking me again?

Brother Hu, who was standing at the door blowing hot air, twitched his lips when he saw the person coming: "Be careful, Tang Yan and Shi Shi both want to treat you to breakfast."

"Oh. Just eat, I just didn't eat."

Damn...where did you learn this kind of self-confidence?

If it weren't for the shamelessness, Brother Hu would have bowed down on the spot - please teach me.

Humming a little tune, Wei Mu strode into the dressing room.

"Good morning, everyone."
